Administering KoldFusion Server

Mail

The Mail Server Connection Settings page tells CFMAIL which SMTP server to use, and lets you look after the mail spool.

Go there: Open the Mail page (or inside the frameset)

Setting Default What it does
Mail Server (blank) Host name or IP address of the SMTP server, such as mail.company.com
Server Port 25 The SMTP port
Connection Timeout 60 seconds How long to wait for the mail server to answer
Spool Interval 15 seconds How often the spooler delivers waiting messages (at least 1)

A CFMAIL tag with its own SERVER, PORT or TIMEOUT attribute overrides these settings for that message.

Buttons

  • Apply saves the settings.
  • Verify saves them, then connects to the mail server and reports whether it answered like an SMTP server should.
  • Deliver Now processes the spool right away instead of waiting for the next spool interval.
  • Respool Undeliverable (shown only when needed) moves every message in the undeliverable folder back to the spool and tries again.

The Mail Spool

The page shows how many messages are waiting in the spool (kfroot/mail/spool/) and how many are in the undeliverable folder (kfroot/mail/undelivr/). The first ten undeliverable messages are listed with their size and date. A message ends up there when the server could not be reached or refused it; the reason is in mail.log (see Log Files).

Tips

  • If mail is not arriving, click Verify first. Most problems are a wrong server name or a firewall.
  • Fix the setting, then click Respool Undeliverable. Nothing is lost.
  • To keep a record of everything that goes out, see Mail Logging.
